topics.title: Sorceries
summary: Sorceries (魔術, Majutsu) are a medium of spells in Elden Ring.

All sorceries require some FP to be cast and the majority of them require a heavy investment into the Intelligence stat, however, there are still some Faith and Arcane-based sorceries to be found. Sorceries can only be manifested through the use of Staves acting as a catalyst.

The actual damage or effect per casting of a Sorcery is based on a unique stat of Staves called Sorcery Scaling, or SS. The value of this stat for any staff depends on the quality of the staff, its Strengthening level, and a combination of your relevant Stats and Attributes combined with the staff's Grade Ratio for those attributes (primarily focusing on Intelligence). Individual spells will have their Power ratio represented as % SS (such as POWER: 75% SS), which represents the percentage of an equipped staff's Sorcery Scaling value that is used for each shot. Do note that enemy resistances will factor into how much damage you see an enemy take; the Power % shown for attack spells is based on calculations done on unarmored neutral critters in the starting zones.

text: Comet Azur, Founding Rain of Stars, Ranni's Dark Moon, and Stars of Ruin must be acquired to complete the Legendary Sorceries and Incantations achievement.
Night Sorceries are sometimes referred to as Invisibility Sorceries.
Loretta's Greatbow and Loretta's Mastery are not affected by either the Carian Glintblade Staff or the Carian Glintstone Staff.
The Envoy Crown does not increase the effectiveness of Clayman bubble Sorceries.

topics.title: Incantations
summary: Incantations (祈祷, Kitō; lit. "Prayers") are a type of spell in Elden Ring.

All incantations require FP to cast, with most necessitating a high investment in the Faith stat. However, some incantations are based on Intelligence or Arcane. The Incantation Scaling varies depending on their stat requirements and the player's own stats.
Incantations can only be cast using sacred seals, which act as the required catalyst.

text: The Clawmark Seal and Cinquedea boosts Bestial incantations by 10% each.
The Dragon Communion Seal boosts Dragon Communion incantations by 15%.
The Dryleaf Seal Shadow of the Erdtree boosts specific Golden Order and Miquella's incantations by 15%.
→ (Discus of Light, Multilayered Ring of Light Shadow of the Erdtree, Radagon's Rings of Light, & Triple Rings of Light only)

The Fire Knight's Seal Shadow of the Erdtree, Messmer's Helm Shadow of the Erdtree/Messmer's Helm (Altered) Shadow of the Erdtree, and Fire Knight Armor Shadow of the Erdtree (not the Altered version) boosts Messmer's Flame incantations by 15%, 3%, and 4% respectively.
The Frenzied Flame Seal boosts Frenzied Flame incantations by 20%.
The Giant's Seal boosts Giants' Flame incantations by 20%.
→ The incantations Catch Flame, Fire's Deadly Sin, and Flame Sling aren't boosted, as they lack a sigil.
The Godslayer's Seal boosts Godslayer incantations (except for Noble Presence) by 10%.
→ Godskin Noble Robe boosts Noble Presence by 20%.
The Golden Order Seal and Radiant Gold Mask boost Golden Order incantations by 10% each.
The Gravel Stone Seal boosts Dragon Cult incantations by 15%.
The Spiraltree Seal Shadow of the Erdtree boosts Spiral incantations by 20%.
Each piece of the Crucible Axe Set and Crucible Tree Set boosts Aspects of the Crucible incantations by 3.5% (14% total for a full set).
The Divine Bird Helm Shadow of the Erdtree boosts the effectiveness of Divine Bird Feathers Shadow of the Erdtree by 10%.

The Enraged Divine Beast Shadow of the Erdtree talisman and Divine Beast Helm Shadow of the Erdtree/Divine Beast Head Shadow of the Erdtree boosts the effectiveness of Divine Beast Tornado Shadow of the Erdtree by 10%.
The Pelt of Ralva Shadow of the Erdtree boosts the effectiveness of Roar of Rugalea Shadow of the Erdtree by 15%.
Flame of the Fell God, Greyoll's Roar, and Elden Stars are required to complete the Legendary Sorceries and Incantations achievement.
No sacred seal boosts Bear Communion, Blood Oath, Divine Beast, Erdtree, Erdtree Worship, Servants of Rot, or Two Fingers incantations.
→ The Erdtree Seal does not boost Erdtree or Erdtree Worship incantations.
→ The Finger Seal does not boost Two Fingers incantations.

The following incantations do not produce spell sigils and are unaffected by school-specific boosts: Catch Flame, Divine Beast Tornado Shadow of the Erdtree, Divine Bird Feathers Shadow of the Erdtree, Fire's Deadly Sin, Flame Sling, Roar of Rugalea Shadow of the Erdtree, Placidusax's Ruin, and Watchful Spirit Shadow of the Erdtree.
[Bugs]
The Dryleaf Seal does not boost the effectiveness of Light of Miquella Shadow of the Erdtree.
The Spiraltree Seal does not boost the effectiveness of Divine Beast Incantations.
